page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-4 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the c4d server family. It features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 15.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 3.75 GB of RAM per core. This configuration does not include any bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data.

The dedicated CPU allocation ensures that compute resources are fully assigned to the instance without sharing cycles with other tenants. With a balanced ratio of compute to memory, this server type is designed for general-purpose workloads, web serving, microservices, and lightweight database hosting. The lack of complimentary public IPv4 addresses and local storage means network and storage architectures must be configured externally.
